In detail

Residential Den Haag. The Hague's own figures are published per wijk through Den Haag in Cijfers and the national Veiligheidsmonitor, a population survey run for CBS and the Ministry of Justice and Security. This wijk is not among those CBS or the city's reporting single out, in either direction, and no area-specific finding for it turned up. Dashed, because that is an absence of findings and not a checked all-clear.

Wandroz rates Bomen- en Bloemenbuurt in The Hague as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in The Hague. That rating rests on an area-level review that reached no traveller-relevant reporting specific to Bomen- en Bloemenbuurt — no incidents, no recurring problems, nothing documented either way — read together with the character of the area.
